versionPairs.description: A compiled, code-split Bun app whose runtime chunk loads lazily (Bun 1.4.1, `bun build --compile --splitting --format esm --minify`, unpacked with bun-decompile): the entry imports both modules through import() and requires nothing. alpha default-imports a Node built-in and a CommonJS module (Bun's __toESM, defined in the lazy runtime chunk, must run after that chunk's init); beta imports a pre-bundled dependency whose own CommonJS helper is declared in one `var` with values that read Object, its wrapped modules in a later statement. Claude Code's two ordering shapes from 2.1.248 and 2.1.269 (exp218). Generated by ../bun-apps. v1.1.0 changes the alpha report.
